name: ocpi
description: This repository contains the OCPI specification, latest release: [`OCPI 2.2.1`](https://evroaming.org/app/uploads/2021/11/OCPI-2.2.1.pdf)

scripts.build:antora: npm run generate:antora && npm exec -- antora antora-playbook.yml
scripts.build:search: node tools/prepare-pagefind.js && npm exec -- pagefind --site public --glob "ocpi/**/*.html" --force-language en
scripts.build:site: npm run build:antora && npm run build:redoc && npm run build:openapi-diff && npm run build:swagger && npm run build:search
scripts.test: npm run test:openapi-invariants && npm run test:maintenance-tools
